baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins al-mulk, yahkumu, and baynahum before dividing outcomes.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exclusive sovereignty supplies the capacity for adjudication; adjudication cuts a formerly shared field into accountable parties and assigns the believing, intentionally repairing party to bliss.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign authority supplies the effective jurisdiction from which the verdict proceeds.
Adjudication among people supplies the verse's decisive legal operation.
Separation after prior togetherness makes the verdict an active partition of parties.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that God rules on that day and rewards believers.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a causal sequence: uncontested sovereignty enables adjudication, adjudication separates the parties, and the faithful-working party receives its assigned condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus words can be read through cohesion, restraint of corruption, repair, and protective enclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rule is the power that holds an order together; judgment restrains disorder; sound acts oppose corruption; the garden is therefore not only scenery but the shielding enclosure of a repaired order.

activation_trace.role: Cohesion and strength recast dominion as the capacity to keep an order from disintegrating.
Restraint for the sake of correction makes judgment a check on corruption.
Soundness opposed to corruption identifies the deeds as repair work within that order.
A protective covering turns the gardens into defended habitation as well as reward.
A good condition and benefaction name the positive state sustained inside that protection.

changed_reading.before: Gardens of bliss are a pleasant prize appended to a legal verdict.
changed_reading.after: The verdict restores integrity: corrupting forces are restrained, sound action is recognized, and the result is a protected, well-held condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Baynahum can denote the connection among parties as well as the gap separating them, while salihat can carry reconciliation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment operates on the relation between parties, not only on isolated individuals: it can expose, repair, or finally sever the connective field, while intentional acts of reconciliation become a salient species of sound work.

activation_trace.role: The connection standing among parties supplies the relational object upon which judgment acts.
Adjudication provides the procedure that can order a contested relation.
Removal of estrangement supplies a specifically social form of the sound deeds.
Intentional action prevents reconciliation from becoming a merely passive disposition.

changed_reading.before: God judges separate individuals and then sorts them into destinations.
changed_reading.after: God judges the contested relations among people; sound action includes repairing those relations, even while the final judgment may ratify an irreparable separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier separation of named communities is followed by a counterforce in which some people check others so multiple worship spaces survive; empowered believers then maintain practices of public order. This makes judgment between parties a governance of plural relations, not only a destination sorter.

activation_trace.role: The connective field among parties remains the focus anchor for relational governance.
Reconciliation gives sound action a concrete social function.
A judgment that distinguishes truth from falsehood establishes the earlier multi-community adjudicatory frame.
Pushing back harm supplies the preserving force by which conflict can protect rather than erase social plurality.
Part-to-part counterposition makes the preservation mechanism relational and reciprocal.
Granted capacity turns the believing party's soundness into maintained public order.

structural_cues: 22:17 names several communities before using a separation-between construction closely parallel to 22:56.
22:40 makes reciprocal social pressure preserve monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques.
22:41 immediately translates empowerment into recurring communal practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural parties, reciprocal restraint, preserved institutions, and empowered practice; I infer that final judgment governs the relations among parties. A live alternative is that these scenes only precede a strictly classificatory final verdict.

changed_reading.before: Between them marks only the line along which God separates communities at the end.
changed_reading.after: Between them also names a relational field that can be balanced, preserved, repaired, and only finally separated when its claims are judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compact pair believing and doing sound deeds expands into empowered maintenance of recognized good, embodied worship, beneficial action, and strenuous exertion. The rewarded group is identified by an operative pattern rather than a static label.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled assent supplies the inward orientation of the group.
Purposeful action converts inward assent into an observable course of conduct.
Opposition to corruption gives that conduct its repairing direction.
Capacity and enablement show that sound action scales into institutional responsibility.
Recognized good supplies a publicly intelligible norm for repair.
The command to enact good makes the focus phrase explicitly performative.
Enduring success links enacted good to the destination announced in the focus.
Exertion under difficulty prevents sound work from being reduced to effortless moral status.

structural_cues: 22:41 lists established worship, almsgiving, recognized good, and restraint of wrong as the use of empowerment.
22:77 repeats the address to believers and follows bodily acts with doing good.
22:78 closes with exertion, communal witness, worship, almsgiving, and holding fast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated faith-action formula and later unpacks it into bodily, economic, social, and strenuous acts; I infer that 22:56 compresses this whole operative pattern. The live alternative is that the later commands are exhortations rather than a gloss on the rewarded deeds.

changed_reading.before: Those who believed and did good works is a generic eligibility formula.
changed_reading.after: The formula identifies people whose settled trust becomes embodied, public, anti-corruptive labor and persists under difficulty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated believing-working group receives apportioned provision, then those displaced or killed receive good provision and an entrance that satisfies them. Gardens of bliss become a supplied and welcomed habitat, not an ornamental backdrop.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the concrete habitat into which the group is placed.
A place fitting its inhabitant makes bliss a condition of apt settlement.
Apportioned provision gives the repeated faith-action formula a sustaining material outcome.
Goodness opposed to ugliness qualifies the promised provision rather than leaving it abstract.
Entry into an interior turns the garden into an admitted-to dwelling.
Contented acceptance makes the destination experientially fitting to its entrants.

structural_cues: 22:50 repeats the focus group almost verbatim and immediately names forgiveness and noble provision.
22:58-59 follow the focus with good provision and a satisfying entrance.
22:14 and 22:23 earlier repeat the same group and explicitly describe entry into rivered gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated recipients, provision, entry, and satisfaction; I infer that the focus garden is a fully supplied habitat matched to its inhabitants. A live alternative is that each promise is a separate reward image without one habitat mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Gardens of bliss name a generic luxurious reward.
changed_reading.after: They name an admitted-to, provisioned, and fitting habitat in which the displaced faithful are settled and satisfied.

context_deltas.mechanism: An intrusive casting is removed, the signs are made firm, and divergent heart responses emerge as settled receptivity or distant fissure. The focus judgment then reads as the final social adjudication of a truth already stabilized and a division already exposed.

activation_trace.role: Judicial decision remains the direct syntactic operation in the focus.
Disclosure lets the judgment manifest a distinction that was previously latent.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the first operation in the correction sequence.
Making something firm and exact transfers an explicit stabilization sense into the focus's repeated verb.
A group split by disagreement supplies the social fissure that the later judgment resolves.
Low, settled terrain gives receptive hearts the counter-image to the distant fissure.

structural_cues: 22:52 repeats H-K-M immediately before the focus, first for making the signs firm and then in a wisdom epithet.
22:53-54 distribute the stabilized sign into diseased or hardened hearts versus knowing, believing, settled hearts.
22:55 prolongs doubt until the sudden hour, after which 22:56 opens with sovereignty and judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removal, stabilization, divergent hearts, prolonged doubt, and then judgment; I infer an arrow from textual stabilization to exposed human division to final adjudication. A live alternative is that the first H-K-M use is only lexical recurrence and does not color the courtroom sense.

changed_reading.before: He judges between them is an isolated courtroom formula.
changed_reading.after: The verdict consummates a correction process: interference is removed, truth is stabilized, heart responses become visible, and their resulting fissure is decisively judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's dead earth is stirred into growth, while the day immediately before the focus is called barren; shortly after, water makes earth green. Against that sterility, gardens of bliss are a reversal into protected fertility and continuing life.

activation_trace.role: Dense, surging vegetation makes the garden an active growth-state rather than a static enclosure.
Beneficent good condition names the lived result of restored fertility.
Lifeless dryness supplies the initial state in the revival cycle.
Earth and plants stirring with life supplies the transition out of sterility.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the productive endpoint of that transition.
Blocked generation makes the immediately preceding day an image of sterility.
Fresh green growth confirms the post-focus ecological reversal.

structural_cues: 22:5 gives a full dead-earth, water, movement, swelling, and growth sequence.
22:55 places a barren day directly before the focus's gardens.
22:63 returns to water-caused greening shortly after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier revival cycle, an immediately adjacent barren day, and later greening; I infer that the garden reverses sterility into durable fertility. A live alternative is that barren modifies only the punitive day and has no designed contrast with the garden.

changed_reading.before: The barren day and the gardens are unrelated punishment and reward labels.
changed_reading.after: The garden is the fertile counter-state to the barren day: judgment converts exposed sterility into protected, living abundance for the faithful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus legal scene permits a response matching the injury yet immediately places renewed wrong under divine support, pardon, and protective forgiveness. The focus judgment can therefore hold proportional accounting and release together without collapsing either.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication anchors the proportional and pardoning sequence in the focus verdict.
The interval between parties supplies the site where reciprocal claims are measured.
Consequence following offense supplies the retributive side of the legal mechanism.
Equivalence constrains response to a matching measure.
Leaving punishment supplies a live release beyond strict equivalence.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer makes pardon reparative rather than mere cancellation.

structural_cues: 22:60 follows the focus verdict with matched retaliation, renewed victimization, divine aid, pardon, and forgiveness in one sentence.
The paired divine epithets close the proportional sequence rather than appearing in an unrelated section.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, subsequent aggression, aid, pardon, and forgiveness; I infer that these disclose dimensions of the focus judgment. A live alternative is that 22:60 regulates a worldly conflict after the eschatological verdict rather than characterizing that verdict.

changed_reading.before: Divine judgment is a simple binary allocation of reward and punishment.
changed_reading.after: Divine judgment remains decisive while accommodating measured reciprocity, defense of the newly wronged, and a pardoning release beyond retaliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty is tested by effective capacity: ordering worldly systems, holding the sky from collapse, creating, and recovering what is taken. The invoked rivals fail even at creation and recovery, while divine strength holds the whole field together.

activation_trace.role: Cohesion and strength make sovereignty a demonstrated capacity to hold an order together.
Sovereignty retains the exclusive authority claimed by the focus.
Ordering something to serve a purpose supplies operational control rather than titular ownership.
Holding and restraining supplies the anti-collapse action of sovereign power.
Creative origination supplies one capacity the rival objects conspicuously lack.
Extraction from another's grasp supplies the failed recovery test for rival power.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope closes the contrast with the rivals' weakness.

structural_cues: 22:65 describes ordered earth-use, a moving ship, and the sky actively held from falling.
22:73 says the invoked rivals cannot create a fly or recover what it takes; the root of taking has no branch inventory and is used here only structurally.
22:74 contrasts failed estimation of God with divine strength and invincibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies control, restraint, failed rival creation, failed recovery, and strength; I infer these as capability tests that explain why sovereignty is God's on the focus day. A live alternative is that the later signs prove power generally without defining the focus's kingship.

changed_reading.before: The sovereignty claim is a title asserted for the day of judgment.
changed_reading.after: It is an operational claim: the true sovereign can create, coordinate, restrain collapse, recover, and therefore carry adjudication into effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the angel branch shadow a focus surface vocalized as sovereignty; it remains anchored because that branch is explicitly present in the focus inventory and 22:75 activates the same root through selected angel-messengers. Render only as a secondary consonantal and branch echo, never as a claim that al-mulk lexically means angels here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's M-L-K inventory contains both sovereignty and angelic-messenger branches, and 22:75 places divine selection over angels and human messengers nearby.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty is the secure lexical center that must not be displaced by the echo.
The form-distant messenger branch opens a contained possibility that sovereignty acts through relays.
The nearby explicit angel occurrence activates the otherwise remote branch in the focus root.
Selection of a chosen subset supplies the delegation step in the relay model.
Messenger and message supply the transmitting function of the selected agents.

changed_reading.before: Sovereignty is imagined only as undifferentiated possession concentrated at the top.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary echo, God's undivided sovereignty may be enacted through selected messenger relays without being transferred away from God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the praise formula at 22:78 reverberate inside the noun al-na'im and joins it to the shield branch of gardens; it remains anchored by the repeated N-A-M root and the focus garden inventory. Render as a root-level resonance that enriches bliss with excellent guardianship, not as a replacement etymology for al-na'im.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins gardens, a protective J-N-N branch, and N-A-M; the surah closes with holding fast to God and twice acclaiming Him as protector and helper.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering makes the garden capable of carrying a guardianship resonance.
Beneficent good condition remains the lexical center of bliss.
The praise branch opens the contained evaluative echo later made explicit.
Repeated acclaim of the protector and helper reactivates N-A-M as explicit praise.
A preserving hold supplies the action by which excellent patronage protects.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the governing role of the acclaimed patron.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the active help inside protected bliss.

changed_reading.before: Bliss denotes pleasurable abundance inside gardens.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained root resonance, bliss also includes dwelling under the excellent, actively preserving patronage acclaimed at the surah's close.

strongest_changes: The repeated H-K-M sequence turns final judgment into the consummation of corrected and stabilized signs whose reception has already split hearts.
Gardens of bliss become a provisioned, satisfying, protected habitat and the fertile counter-state to the immediately preceding barren day.
Sovereignty becomes demonstrated capacity to coordinate, restrain collapse, create, recover, and enforce judgment.
Belief and sound work expand into embodied, public, anti-corruptive practice rather than a static eligibility label.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms: legal partition, relational governance, restoration of integrity, ecological reversal, and protective settlement. The most fragile but productive echoes connect sovereignty with selected messenger relays and bliss with the closing praise of God as excellent protector and helper.
remaining_uncertainties: The stabilization sense of H-K-M is strongly activated by 22:52 but may remain only a lexical echo beside the direct judicial syntax of 22:56.
The barren-to-garden reversal is structurally sharp but depends on treating the adjacent punitive day as an ecological contrast.
The M-L-K angel relay and N-A-M praise resonance are form-sensitive secondary activations, not lexical substitutions.
Relational repair coexists with, and must not erase, the focus's explicit final separation of parties.
